title: howardia maxima
intro: Howardia maxima, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Aizoaceae. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help soothe wounds and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of Howardia maxima include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and fighting infections.
